title: docs(components): annotate refused runtime-slot handler rows (objectui#8235)
body:
Fixes #8235
Clause-②: no

Implemented by the `os-dev` run the `domain:ui` seat 5 dispatched, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`. Every reading below was taken at BASE `bc4efba73` (the `origin/main` commit the worktree was cut from). The gates ran at HEAD `152f935`. Generic brackets in row texts are spelled `Record OF string, any` and `Promise OF void`, because GitHub strips tag-shaped fragments from PR bodies.

## What changed

Twelve component reference pages each have one `## Schema` row for an `on*` key. The zod twin of that node refuses the key by name, through `handlerKeyRefusal(KEY, 'runtime-slot', LABEL)`. Each of these rows now has the same two-line annotation directly above it:

```text
// RUNTIME SLOT (objectui#6124): a React host supplies it; JSON refuses it
// by name. Author behaviour as a node type, e.g. an action:button node.
```

The row itself and its callable type stay as they were. On the three menu pages (context-menu, dropdown-menu, menubar), the paragraph under the fence also changes. It used to say "Handlers are declared on the **item**, not on the menu: the shipped `MenuItem` declares `onClick`...", which tells a JSON author to write `onClick` on the item. It now says that the item's `onClick` is a runtime slot a React host supplies through the TypeScript `MenuItem` interface, that it has no JSON spelling, and that the validator refuses it by name on the item. That is the spelling the alert-dialog page already uses for `onAction`.

This PR changes docs only: 12 files, +36 / -9 lines. No schema, export or accept set moves. No changeset is owed: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` prints "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed."

## Classification pass (the triage asked for this before any sweep)

Instruments:

- **census**: the card's own regex, `grep -rn '^\s*on[A-Z][A-Za-z]*[?]\?:' content/docs/components/`.
- **refusal set**: every `handlerKeyRefusal('KEY', 'DISPOSITION', ...)` call in `packages/types/src/zod/*.ts`, attributed to the `const` that encloses it.
- **probe**: `safeParse` on a minimal node, once without the key and once with it. The key is authored as the string `"handleEvent"`, because JSON has no function value. Each node is parsed against the named schema export and against `safeValidateSchema`. The node without the key parses GREEN in every case.

**H1, the census.** At BASE the census returns **16 rows**. The card counted 17 at `f57ca757b`. The missing row is `feedback/toast.mdx`: its `ToastSchema` fence has no `on*` member at BASE. The rows for menubar and pagination have moved to different lines. After this change the census returns the same 16 rows, byte-identical with line numbers stripped: `diff` exits 0.

**H2, the refusal set.** At BASE, 98 `handlerKeyRefusal` calls name 50 distinct keys, so the card's 34-key list is stale. One correction to the card affects the classification. The card says no refusal names `onNodeClick`, but `TreeViewSchema` does refuse it, as runtime-slot.

| page | key | judged by | disposition | probe with key | verdict | remedy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| overlay/context-menu.mdx | `onClick` | `MenuItemSchema` command arm, nested item via `ContextMenuSchema.items` | runtime-slot | RED `invalid_union` at `items.0` | admitted | annotate, paragraph rewritten |
| overlay/menubar.mdx | `onClick` | `MenuItemSchema` command arm, nested item via `MenubarMenuSchema.items` | runtime-slot | RED `invalid_union` at `menus.0.items.0` | admitted | annotate, paragraph rewritten |
| overlay/dropdown-menu.mdx | `onClick` | `MenuItemSchema` command arm, nested item via `DropdownMenuSchema.items` | runtime-slot | RED `invalid_union` at `items.0` | admitted | annotate, paragraph rewritten |
| data-display/tree-view.mdx | `onNodeClick` | `TreeViewSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onNodeClick` | admitted | annotate |
| form/form.mdx | `onSubmit` | `FormSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onSubmit` | admitted | annotate |
| form/input-otp.mdx | `onChange` | `InputOTPSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onChange` | admitted | annotate |
| form/button.mdx | `onClick` | `ButtonSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onClick` | admitted | annotate |
| form/date-picker.mdx | `onChange` | `DatePickerSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onChange` | admitted | annotate |
| complex/filter-builder.mdx | `onChange` | `FilterBuilderSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onChange` | admitted | annotate |
| disclosure/accordion.mdx | `onValueChange` | `AccordionSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onValueChange` | admitted (card-confirmed) | annotate |
| disclosure/toggle-group.mdx | `onValueChange` | `ToggleGroupSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onValueChange` | admitted (card-confirmed) | annotate |
| basic/pagination.mdx | `onPageChange` | `PaginationSchema`, top level | runtime-slot | RED `custom` at `onPageChange` | admitted (card-confirmed) | annotate |
| complex/view-switcher.mdx | `onViewChange` (`string`) | `ViewSwitcherSchema`: `z.string()`, an event NAME | none | GREEN | classified: not refused | left as is |
| complex/sort-ui.mdx | `onChange` (`string`) | `SortUISchema`: `z.string()`, an event NAME | none | GREEN | classified: not refused | left as is |
| complex/filter-ui.mdx | `onChange` (`string`) | `FilterUISchema`: `z.string()`, an event NAME | none | GREEN | classified: not refused | left as is |
| basic/button-group.mdx | `onClick` (`never`) | `ButtonGroupButtonSchema`, nested item | retired | RED `custom` at `buttons.0.onClick` | already annotated | left as is |
| feedback/toast.mdx | (no row at BASE) | none | none | none | absent | none |

Totals: 12 admitted (3 on the nested `MenuItemSchema`, 9 on top-level schemas), 3 classified as not refused, 1 already correct, 1 absent.

## Why each admitted row is annotated, not deleted, moved to prose or spelled `never`

All 12 admitted keys have the `'runtime-slot'` disposition. `handlerKeyRefusal`'s own doc says the TypeScript twin keeps such keys callable, and the shipped interfaces do. Spelling them `never` would therefore misstate the TypeScript face. `never` belongs to `'retired'` keys, such as the button-group row.

Deleting a row or moving it to prose fails in a different way. `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-docs-retired-handler-keys-7340.test.ts` pins four of these rows in its CONTROL block, "runtime-slot rows are NOT flagged — the blanket-sweep control (objectui#7340)", as present and callable:

- pagination `onPageChange`
- tree-view `onNodeClick`
- button `onClick`
- input-otp `onChange`

I measured this at HEAD `152f935`, using objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` to wrap that one test file:

- leg 1 deletes the pagination row (the delete or prose remedy);
- leg 2 spells the button row `onClick?: never;` (the `never` remedy).

Both edits landed on disk (anchor count 1 -> 0 and blob changed, for each file). The result was `Tests 2 failed | 17 passed (19)`. The two failures were `'components/basic/pagination.mdx' still documents ...` and `'components/form/button.mdx' still documents ...`. Both files were then restored, which I checked by the blob hash matching HEAD and by `git diff HEAD` being empty, not by the exit code.

An in-place annotation brings the row in line with the refusal and keeps that pin green. I used one form on all 12 pages so they don't diverge. This card's triage and the objectui#7340 CONTROL still disagree about runtime-slot rows. I put that to the PM seat in the dev report and did not settle it here.

## Rows before and after

At BASE the census returned these 16 rows, listed by page with the row text:

- overlay/context-menu.mdx: `onClick?: () => void;  // Click handler`
- overlay/menubar.mdx: `onClick?: () => void;  // Click handler`
- overlay/dropdown-menu.mdx: `onClick?: () => void;  // Click handler`
- data-display/tree-view.mdx: `onNodeClick?: (node: TreeNode) => void; // Node click handler`
- form/form.mdx: `onSubmit?: (data: Record OF string, any) => void | Promise OF void;`
- form/input-otp.mdx: `onChange?: (value: string) => void;`
- form/button.mdx: `onClick?: () => void | Promise OF void;  // Click handler`
- form/date-picker.mdx: `onChange?: (date: Date | undefined) => void;`
- complex/view-switcher.mdx: `onViewChange?: string;`
- complex/filter-builder.mdx: `onChange?: (filter: FilterGroup) => void;  // Change handler`
- complex/sort-ui.mdx: `onChange?: string;`
- complex/filter-ui.mdx: `onChange?: string;`
- disclosure/accordion.mdx: `onValueChange?: (value: string | string[]) => void;`
- disclosure/toggle-group.mdx: `onValueChange?: (value: string | string[]) => void;`
- basic/button-group.mdx: `onClick?: never;  // RETIRED (objectui#6124) — author behaviour`
- basic/pagination.mdx: `onPageChange?: (page: number) => void;`

The card's 17th row, `feedback/toast.mdx`, was already absent at BASE.

After this change the census returns the same 16 row texts. The 12 admitted rows now have the two-line `RUNTIME SLOT (objectui#6124)` annotation directly above them: the first eight rows above, filter-builder, accordion, toggle-group and pagination. `grep -c 'RUNTIME SLOT (objectui#6124)'` finds 1 on each of those 12 pages. The other four rows are unchanged.

## Gates, run at HEAD `152f935` (exit codes captured before any pipe)

| command | exit | verdict line |

| `pnpm check:docs-route-closure` | 0 | MEASURED_PAYLOAD is honest |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | check-control-bytes: OK |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | 0 new citation(s) |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | report-only: 2 pending changesets name `filter-builder.mdx` (`6939-filter-builder-mirror`, `7562-filter-field-type-fourteen-members`); both paragraphs read, both still true (they concern `FilterField.value` / `type`, which this diff leaves as is) |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 | No test source names a pending changeset. |

| `pnpm docs:check-links` (added) | 0 | Links are valid across 17 scan roots. |
| `pnpm check:shell-escape-residue` (added) | 0 | OK |

| `pnpm check:doc-snippets` | 2 | PRECONDITION NOT MET, so **NOT MEASURED** |
| `pnpm check:doc-examples` | 2 | PRECONDITION NOT MET, so **NOT MEASURED** |

**Tests.** I selected test files with two greps over the 117 tracked test files that mention `content/docs`. One grep picks the files that name an edited page (5). The other picks the files that contain a directory-walk call (`readdirSync`, `globSync`, `walk(`, `git ls-files`): 40. The two sets overlap by 2, so 43 files in all. Command: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on those 43 files, under `os-verify-lock`. Result: `Test Files 43 passed (43)`, `Tests 2182 passed (2182)`, at HEAD `152f935`. The selection is a heuristic, not a proof of coverage; CI runs the full suite.

**NOT MEASURED: doc-snippets and doc-examples.** Both gates exited 2 because the `--build-filter` closure of 34 packages is not built in this worktree. CI runs both. They cannot see this diff by construction. doc-snippets compiles only `ts` and `tsx` fences, and all 12 edited fences are `plaintext`: each fence's opener is unchanged, and `check:doc-fences` is green. doc-examples reads `SchemaExample` fixtures, and this diff touches none. This confirms H3: no gate reads these rows. The objectui#7340 pin above is a test, not a gate.

## Acceptance notes

- Outside the card's `on*` instrument: the `renderCellEditor` row in the `complex/data-table.mdx` `## Schema` fence has the same defect class. `DataTableSchema` refuses it by name as runtime-slot; the probe returns RED `custom` at `renderCellEditor`, and GREEN without the key. I found it by widening the census to all 50 refused keys. I did not touch it; it is in the dev report for the seat.
- The triage ruled the `pagination.mdx` `currentPage` / `pageSize` / `totalItems` drift out of scope. It is untouched.
- The census has no gate behind it. Re-run the regex above to re-derive it, and re-run the `handlerKeyRefusal` enumeration for the refusal set. The counts in this body are readings at BASE `bc4efba73`, not live figures.
